Hi Elena & Mark —

Thanks again for your time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the committee and get procurement moving: 

1) Demo highlights (what we showed)
- Live inference with Redwood-optimized runtime (p95 single-token latency in the demo ~280ms)
- Prefix caching and batching behavior for steady-state throughput
- RBAC / VPC option for private deployments and KMS integration for keys

2) Who we believe is in the committee (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Mark Thompson (Finance / VP Ops) — likely to own budget decision
- Security / compliance reviewer: Internal InfoSec + Procurement point (Procurement team)
- Product champion: Elena Ruiz (Clinical AI) — driving evaluation criteria
- Platform/infra reviewer: TBD (your SRE/Cloud team)

3) Decision criteria we recommend capturing now:
- Performance: p95 inference latency target and throughput (we suggested p95 < 350ms at expected load)
- Cost: expected cost per 1k tokens for production traffic (we'll provide model profiles)
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II evidence + data residency and audit logs
- Integration effort: ETA for prototype (2–3 weeks) and API compatibility

4) Proposed evaluation plan (pilot-focused, 2 weeks):
- Scope: 2 endpoints (summarization + note-generation), 1k sample transcripts, production-like traffic for 48h load window
- Success metrics: latency p95 < 350ms, accuracy accept-rate >= 90% on your test set, no PII leakage incidents in test harness
- Data handling: ephemeral logs by default; we can enable retention and audit streaming to your S3/KMS if needed

5) Immediate asks / next actions:
- Please confirm the economic buyer (Mark) and the primary procurement contact (Procurement) — we listed contacts above
- Procurement: we can provide a one-page vendor summary + the filled security questionnaire (attached) for your packet
- Legal: we can prepare standard MSA + proposed pilot amendment and send via DocuSign
- Schedule: suggest pilot kickoff w/c Jun 27 (two-week window) — are you available for a 30-min alignment call next Tue/Thu?

Attachments: RDW-Demo-Slides.pdf (slides), security-questionnaire-filled.pdf (answers to initial security questions)

Open to edits — I can send a condensed one-pager for procurement if that helps.

Thanks,
Karthik

- Pilot duration: 14 calendar days; 48-hour steady-state load test in week 2.
- Performance gate: p95 latency < 350ms for the sample traffic (we'll provide traffic shape).

- SLA / fallback: auto-failover to lower-cost model variant if latency spike during pilot > 500ms for > 5 minutes.
